```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

# Conectar a base de dados
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "database.sqlite3")
```

```{r}
query_quantos_professores <- "
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS quantidade_professores
  FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t ON i.id = t.instructor_id
  JOIN sections s ON t.section_uuid = s.uuid
  JOIN course_offerings co ON s.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects sub ON sm.subject_code = sub.code
  WHERE sub.abbreviation = 'STAT';
"
cat("Quantidade de professores:\n")
print(dbGetQuery(conn, query_quantos_professores))

query_quem_sao <- "
  SELECT DISTINCT i.name AS nome_professor
  FROM instructors i
  JOIN teachings t ON i.id = t.instructor_id
  JOIN sections s ON t.section_uuid = s.uuid
  JOIN course_offerings co ON s.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
  JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
  JOIN subjects sub ON sm.subject_code = sub.code
  WHERE sub.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  ORDER BY i.name;
"
cat("\nLista de professores:\n")
print(head(dbGetQuery(conn, query_quem_sao), 10))
```

```{r}
sql_gpa_cte <- "
  WITH NotasEstatistica AS (
    SELECT 
      i.name AS professor,
      c.name AS disciplina,
      (gd.a_count * 4.0 + gd.ab_count * 3.5 + gd.b_count * 3.0 + 
       gd.bc_count * 2.5 + gd.c_count * 2.0 + gd.d_count * 1.0 + gd.f_count * 0.0) AS pontos_totais,
      (gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count + 
       gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) AS alunos_avaliados
    FROM grade_distributions gd
    JOIN course_offerings co ON gd.course_offering_uuid = co.uuid
    JOIN courses c ON co.course_uuid = c.uuid
    JOIN subject_memberships sm ON co.uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
    JOIN subjects sub ON sm.subject_code = sub.code
    JOIN sections s ON co.uuid = s.course_offering_uuid AND gd.section_number = s.number
    JOIN teachings t ON s.uuid = t.section_uuid
    JOIN instructors i ON t.instructor_id = i.id
    WHERE sub.abbreviation = 'STAT'
  )
"

# Professor mais difícil 
query_prof_dificil <- paste0(sql_gpa_cte, "
  SELECT professor, SUM(pontos_totais) / SUM(alunos_avaliados) AS gpa_medio
  FROM NotasEstatistica
  GROUP BY professor
  HAVING SUM(alunos_avaliados) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa_medio ASC
  LIMIT 1;
")
cat("\nProfessor mais difícil:\n")
print(dbGetQuery(conn, query_prof_dificil))

# Professor mais fácil
query_prof_facil <- paste0(sql_gpa_cte, "
  SELECT professor, SUM(pontos_totais) / SUM(alunos_avaliados) AS gpa_medio
  FROM NotasEstatistica
  GROUP BY professor
  HAVING SUM(alunos_avaliados) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa_medio DESC
  LIMIT 1;
")
cat("\nProfessor mais fácil:\n")
print(dbGetQuery(conn, query_prof_facil))

# Disciplina mais difícil
query_disc_dificil <- paste0(sql_gpa_cte, "
  SELECT disciplina, SUM(pontos_totais) / SUM(alunos_avaliados) AS gpa_medio
  FROM NotasEstatistica
  GROUP BY disciplina
  HAVING SUM(alunos_avaliados) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa_medio ASC
  LIMIT 1;
")
cat("\nDisciplina mais difícil:\n")
print(dbGetQuery(conn, query_disc_dificil))

# Disciplina mais fácil
query_disc_facil <- paste0(sql_gpa_cte, "
  SELECT disciplina, SUM(pontos_totais) / SUM(alunos_avaliados) AS gpa_medio
  FROM NotasEstatistica
  GROUP BY disciplina
  HAVING SUM(alunos_avaliados) > 0
  ORDER BY gpa_medio DESC
  LIMIT 1;
")
cat("\nDisciplina mais fácil:\n")
print(dbGetQuery(conn, query_disc_facil))
```
